name: manual_1fa650
claim: A free pair dogfood (inner seat, Scout, outer seat Biafra, no model call, no gate, no network) proves the contracts and seat boundaries: distinct valid attempts, stall detection from the ledger, a validated Mechanism Card citing the stalled ids, an untouched evaluator digest, verifier paths refused, no retry. It does not prove a model proposes a good search rule; that needs a live cycle with the operator gate, a named budget and a same-day provider re-probe. State that limit wherever the dogfood is cited.
conditions: dogfood pair biafra autoresearcher proves boundaries not model quality

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: tests/test_pair_dogfood.py passes 6 tests and produced a receipt; docs/v2/76 section 9 records the same limit.
